intro: Pick the best one. Hints are here if you want them.

items.stem: Which one explains the evidence from Document 7?

options.1: This shows Marshall said the laws of Georgia could have no force at all on the Cherokee Nation's land
options.2: This shows the Court sided with the Cherokee against a state, which matters because removal went ahead anyway
options.3: This shows the case was decided in 1832 by Chief Justice John Marshall of the Supreme Court
options.4: This shows the Supreme Court was an important part of the government during the Jackson presidency

hints: One of these just says the quotation again in different words.
items.reason: Option 1 restates the evidence. Option 3 summarises the source line. Option 4 is true and has nothing to do with the claim. Only option 2 says what it shows and why that matters.

items.stem: Which one explains the evidence from Document 3?

options.1: This shows the canal reached the Great Lakes and extended navigable water a thousand miles inland
options.2: This shows the canal gave western farmers a market, which matters because growth paid off for some Americans
options.3: This shows Guthrie was the Secretary of the Treasury and reported to Congress about the nation's economy
options.4: This shows canals were a very important form of transportation across the United States during the early 1800s

hints: Which one gets past what the document said and onto what it meant?
Only one of these could be used in an argument.
items.reason: Option 1 repeats the document. Option 3 explains the author, not the evidence. Option 4 is a general fact about canals. Option 2 names the consequence and ties it to the question of whether expansion was worth it.

items.stem: Your claim is that expansion cost more than it was worth. Which explanation ties the evidence back to it?

options.1: This shows Jackson promised removal would benefit everyone, which matters because the Trail of Tears proved otherwise
options.2: This shows Jackson gave his Second Annual Message to Congress in December of the year 1830
options.3: This shows Jackson thought removal would be good for the United States and for the Native nations
options.4: This shows presidents in the 1830s had a great deal of influence over what Congress decided to do

hints: Three of these never mention your claim.
Which one ends somewhere your argument can use?
items.reason: Option 2 is the source line. Option 3 restates Jackson. Option 4 wanders off. Option 1 says what the evidence shows, why it matters, and lands on the cost the claim is about.
